note: One entry per converter build that produced (or will produce) MCCB runs. A comparison with an unidentified or untraceable build is not accepted.

converters.name: WorldSwitch
converters.publisher: WorldSwitch (maintainer of MCCB — conflict of interest, see METHODOLOGY §8)

builds.ci: GitHub Actions 'security' workflow green on this commit (private repository)
builds.deployed_on_web_service: unknown — the service exposes no build identifier
builds.how_run: tools/runners/worldswitch/run-suite.mjs: engine library called in a fresh Node.js process per conversion, as the web service's conversion child process does
builds.options_rationale: Defaults of the public upload form: target 'latest' (Bedrock 1.26.40 profile) unless the user picks 1.21.60; no Java account UUID unless typed; recovery of unlinked player inventories on. locale only changes texts written by the engine.

output_formats.java: DataVersion 3700 (Java 1.20.4 layout), upgraded by the game on first open

builds.sidecars: Outputs embed java_sidecar.bin (Bedrock worlds) / bedrock_sidecar.bin (Java worlds) used to restore data on a return conversion; they are not read by the games and do not count for direct fidelity.

builds.options_rationale: Output formats matching the MCCB references (Java 26.3, Bedrock 1.26.40); every other setting left at its default.
builds.declared_limitations: README: "Entities (excluding paintings / item frames)" are listed among currently unsupported features.
